title: Distributed Execution Legacy Parity v1
description: Frozen authority for the six current-main execution-source kinds and their legacy parity matrix. Each kind declares required/forbidden source fields, opaque requester/executor principal kinds, its owning current-main crosswalk CM rows, and a behavior (or a justified not_applicable) for every parity dimension. Only task_run carries run/issue identity; the other five carry opaque typed provenance. Consumed by PRT-002/003/006/007, TEN-006, JOB-010..014, CLI-005, and MIG-005/006/007. Locked by Decision #121; the migration inventory that owns cutover of these sources is current-main-crosswalk.md.
sentinelNote: The fail-open DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_ID sentinel ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', @armyofagents/shared) and its nil-ULID fixture-namespace form ('org_' + 26 zeros). TEN-006 removes the sentinel default; JOB-010 rejects sentinel/unmapped Organization admission before persistence. No execution source may be admitted against a sentinel Organization.

parity.checkout_assignment: Atomic single-agent checkout on issues via SELECT FOR UPDATE NO WAIT; reviewerUserId materialized on entry to in_review; the domain run stays product authority.
parity.capacity_claim_release_wakeup: min(perAgentSlots, ORG_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS) atomic capacity claim; excess work queued; queued work woken on release; a failed or terminal claim is released once (CM-014).
parity.product_runtime_approval: Effective completion policy (review_required or agent_can_complete); runtime decisions surface through ask_human / work_questions.
parity.budget: Company/department budget hard-stop preflight; cost_events recorded per run.
parity.cost: cost_events per-agent/per-run; token usage and cost projected on the run summary.
parity.output_run_summary: postRunSummaryComment on the issue; task_outputs / artifactId output capture.
parity.completion_cancel_retry: review_required or agent completion under the snapshot policy; cancel via cancel_requested; retry is a new fenced attempt.

checkout_assignment.justification: A Commander turn is a per-conversation warm lease (Decision #120, environment_leases.commanderConversationId), not an issue-locked run; there is no task checkout or assignee.

parity.capacity_claim_release_wakeup: Warm paused/resumed per-conversation E2B lease claim/pause/resume; the warm reaper bounds idle leases; the instance flag may choose ephemeral-per-turn behavior.
parity.budget: internal_agent_config budget; per-turn cost projected on internal_agent_runs.
parity.output_run_summary: SSE stream and internal_agent_messages persistence into the one persistent conversation; no issue run-summary comment or artifact version is produced.
parity.completion_cancel_retry: The turn completes on the assistant reply; abort cancels the turn; Retry/Edit re-runs it; there is no task-completion policy.

parity.checkout_assignment: Crew dispatch assigns the discussion-spawned issue (issues.originKind='crew_thread'); the planning->standard gate governs dispatchability.
parity.capacity_claim_release_wakeup: Crew per-agent slot plus the per-Organization clamp; the crew_dispatch Inbox approval flips planning->standard and dispatches; release/wakeup follow the shared capacity primitive.
parity.product_runtime_approval: Crew autonomy dial (crew_autonomy_level: Manual/Assist/Drive); Assist raises one crew_dispatch approval; crew tool calls are not subject to Commander runtime-approval policy.
parity.budget: preflightCrewDispatch company budget hard-stop plus thread pause/disable.
parity.output_run_summary: postRunSummaryComment on the task plus relayCrewResult / postCrewFailureCard loopback into the originating thread (W3a).
parity.completion_cancel_retry: Effective completion policy; thread pause/disable cancels; retry is a re-dispatch as a new fenced attempt.

checkout_assignment.justification: A one-shot extraction/compaction/readiness-probe is not backed by an issue or domain run (CM-007); it carries a typed actor, not a task checkout or assignee, and never a fabricated runId/issueId.

parity.capacity_claim_release_wakeup: Bounded batch sandbox handle acquire/reuse/release across the extract-then-scope entry set with partial-failure cleanup; no queued wakeup.

product_runtime_approval.justification: A one-shot has no product review or runtime-approval surface; it returns a single structured result (extracted items, compaction output, or a readiness/auth verdict).

parity.budget: Company model-provider key audience and containment; cost recorded against the Company.
parity.audit: activity_log one-shot record with the typed actor and Company scope.
parity.cost: Input/output token cost recorded; Company-key audience, zero-secret evidence.
parity.output_run_summary: The structured result is returned to the caller (discussion_extracted_items, compacted context, or probe verdict); no run-summary comment is written.
parity.completion_cancel_retry: Atomic claim/replay idempotency; bounded retry; active-operation drain/cancel; no host fallback.

sources.crosswalkNote: A net-new target-only workload class; current main has no distributed browser execution sink, so there is no CM row. Owned by BRW-001..006 in program-design.md.

parity.checkout_assignment: The browser session is assigned to a browser_worker under the browserSession lifecycle; no issue checkout.
parity.capacity_claim_release_wakeup: Browser-session lease claim and release; the session lifecycle bounds concurrency.
parity.product_runtime_approval: Download and egress approval (requested_granted / requested_denied); runtime egress decisions gate outbound bytes.
parity.budget: Per-session budget; cost recorded against the Company.
parity.output_run_summary: Approved download artifact capture plus a session summary; no issue run-summary comment.
parity.completion_cancel_retry: The session completes, is cancelled, or expires; retry is a new fenced session attempt.

sources.crosswalkNote: A net-new target-only workload class; a service is desired state plus reconciled instances (Decision #121), not a current-main sink, so there is no CM row. Owned by SVC-001..007 in program-design.md.

parity.checkout_assignment: The reconciler converges serviceDesired into serviceInstance rows and assigns instances; this is desired-state reconciliation, not an issue checkout.
parity.capacity_claim_release_wakeup: Instance capacity claim and release under scale reconciliation; no queued task wakeup.

product_runtime_approval.justification: A service reconcile has no per-run product review or runtime-approval surface; it converges desired state rather than completing a reviewable unit of work.

parity.budget: Service budget stop (the budget_stop runtime decision halts reconciliation).
parity.output_run_summary: Instance health and checkpoint state; no per-run summary comment.
parity.completion_cancel_retry: The service reconciles to healthy or stopped; cancellation flows through the desired state; restart is a checkpoint restore on a new instance attempt.
